messages:
matt: Quick heads-up — planning to push a release-train slot tomorrow 11:00 PDT. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness?

ana: I can take smoke for model-serving and inference routes (latency, kv cache warmup, sanity prompts). 11:00 works.

sam: I’ll cover webapp + infra checks (LB, nginx, autoscaler, pod restarts). Will be available 10:45–11:30.

jen: Note: this deploy includes a small online migration (add nullable index on users.last_active). Rollback = revert migration + redeploy prior image. I’ll be on standby for migration roll-forward/rollback.

lia: Heads-up — eu-west Dedicated pools are at ~85% reserved for the day. Can we route canary to us-east first and only spill to eu-west if green?

matt: Good call. Plan: canary -> us-east, monitor 5m, then stagger to other regions. If latency spike > 30% on p95 or error rate > 0.5% we stop and revert.

matt: @deploy-bot, please schedule slot and create canary route as below:
```
canary: 3% routes -> model-serving-v2 (us-east)
wait: 5m
if ok: 25% -> add us-west
if ok: 100% -> add eu-west
fallback: previous-model-serving image
```

deploy-bot: ✅ Scheduled deploy slot 11:00 PDT (slot id: slot-305555). Canary routing created. Notifying on-call.

ana: Smoke checklist I’ll run (short):
1) /health on model-serving across nodes
2) sample prompts (sanity + long-context) — verify outputs unchanged
3) kv cache warm-up (simulate long seqs)
4) token-perf comparison vs baseline
5) check logs for memory OOMs and slow kernels

sam: Infra checklist:
- LB health endpoints green
- Pod restart test (kubectl rollout restart) on a canary node
- Prometheus alert thresholds ready (p95, p99, cpu/gpu util)
- Smoke load ~10 qps for 3m

jen: I’ll validate migration diff and dry-run locally before cut. If anything blocks, I’ll annotate the deploy thread.

matt: Thanks. If everyone is OK, I’ll mark owners: smoke-> ana + sam, rollback-> jen, routing-> matt, watchers-> lia. Please ping in this thread once you start smoke.

ana: Ack — will post smoke start + results.

sam: Ack. I’ll post infra logs and a quick pass/fail.

jen: Ack, standing by.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary will begin at 11:00 PDT. Use /deploy abort <slot-id> to stop.

matt: Perfect — thanks team :rocket:
